verification_limits: The historical 3GiB profile branch was exercised by a controlled synthetic memory measurement, not by resizing the guest's physical RAM.
The direct native optimize_php invocation is not a full WordPress deploy, installation, download or web UI flow; source-level call chain from deploy_wp was separately inspected.
This is one aaPanel 8.0.7 / Debian 12 / Nginx 1.28.3 / PHP-FPM 8.5.12 environment, not a cross-version guarantee.

A successful php-fpm -tt reads the configuration from disk; the separate PHP HTTP checks demonstrated service availability, not exhaustive request/process performance or every effective pool value under load.
File attribution reports only conventional direct aaPanel VHost -> PHP include -> [www] socket relationships; possible extension overrides and worker/runtime routing are not proved.

The 0.1.2 development ZIP was imported through native aaPanel plugin APIs, guest panel restarted, and the installed read-only endpoint executed with guest panel Python. The 0.1.2 browser UI and real temporary/restricted authentication were not replayed.
Real temporary-token and restricted-role browser authorization remain unverified; no Apply or Auto-enforce exists.
No production host, aaPanel vendor source, or public release was changed.
